summary: Added recent megakernel serving, adaptive fusion, weight-resident speculative decoding, MoE replication, training, and design-boundary studies.
Added Weave as a core distributed MoE megakernel with fine-grained runtime SM scheduling for compute-communication overlap.

Added Mixture-of-Kittens to the catalog and timeline with an SM100 source study; added a mechanism-focused MegaKernel note, a curated guide to 30 kernel-related Zhihu readings, and five MegaKernel case studies covering MegaRTP, Hazy, synchronization, MegaQwen, and MegaMoE.
Added a Chinese literature review, transactional bilingual rendering, stricter schema and marker validation, regression tests, localized generated labels, and a second factual audit.
Expanded and reclassified the catalog; added a zero-dependency validator and bilingual README renderer.
